response.text:
You can decline (or simply not give consent) until **Mon 30 Nov 2026**, with the letter itself asking that it be sent by **Tue 24 Nov 2026** to arrive in time [item:itm_9qzfwbhh5m74].

- Musterbank eG wants to raise your Girokonto Klassik fee and needs your explicit consent — silence does not count as agreement [doc:doc_0b2t88kqsf2n].
- If you don't respond (i.e. decline) by that deadline, the bank may end the account with two months' notice instead — but you can also cancel the account yourself at any time, free of charge [item:itm_9qzfwbhh5m74].
- To act on it, mark your choice in Ordnung or reply to the bank via "Postfach › Zustimmungen" or the enclosed form, as described in the letter [doc:doc_0b2t88kqsf2n].
